teaser.en: Turn over one of its leaves and you see why it is called the looking-glass mangrove: the underside shines silver-white.
teaser.sw: Geuza moja ya majani yake na utaona kwa nini kwa Kiingereza unaitwa mkoko wa kioo: upande wa chini hung'aa kwa rangi nyeupe ya fedha.

summary.en: The looking-glass mangrove is a scattered tree of the landward mangrove edge, recognised by leaves that are dark green above and silvery below. It is rare in Kenya, and its wood has gone into boat masts, ships and furniture.
summary.sw: Msikundazi ni mti unaoota kwa kutawanyika ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, na hutambulika kwa majani yaliyo kijani kibichi juu na meupe kama fedha chini. Ni adimu nchini Kenya, na mbao zake zimetumika kwa milingoti ya vyombo, meli na fanicha.

about.en:
This is a tree rather than a shrub, reaching about 8 metres at Gazi. Its leaves are the easiest way to know it: dark, glossy green on top and a bright silvery white underneath, so the canopy flashes pale when the wind turns the leaves over.

The fruit is a woody nut about 6 centimetres long with a sharp keel along one side, a little like the hull of a small boat. The fruits float and wash up along the shore. Older trees often develop buttresses at the base of the trunk.
about.sw:
Huu ni mti badala ya kichaka, na hufikia takriban mita 8 huko Gazi. Majani yake ndiyo njia rahisi zaidi ya kuutambua: kijani kibichi kinachong'aa upande wa juu na weupe angavu wa fedha upande wa chini, hivyo kilele chake humeta kwa weupe upepo unapoyageuza majani.

Tunda lake ni kokwa la mti lenye urefu wa takriban sentimita 6, na lina mgongo mkali upande mmoja, kidogo kama kiini cha mashua ndogo. Matunda haya huelea na kusukumwa ufuoni. Miti mikongwe mara nyingi huota mizizi-ukuta chini ya shina.

where.en: It grows as scattered single trees on the landward edge of the mangroves, never forming its own band as the red and grey mangroves do. At Gazi Bay it reaches about 8 metres. Look for it where the mangrove meets firmer ground, and watch for the silvery flash of leaves or for its keeled nuts lying on the mud.
where.sw: Huota kama miti mmoja mmoja iliyotawanyika ukingoni mwa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu, bila kamwe kuunda safu yake yenyewe kama mkoko na mchu zinavyofanya. Katika Ghuba ya Gazi hufikia takriban mita 8. Utaupata pale mikoko inapokutana na ardhi ngumu zaidi; angalia mng'ao wa fedha wa majani yake au makokwa yake yenye mgongo yaliyolala juu ya tope.

uses.en:
The straight boles have been used for boat masts, in shipbuilding and for furniture, and the wood is excellent firewood.

In Kenya a decoction of the roots is used to treat mouth infections and toothache.
uses.sw:
Mashina yake yaliyonyooka yametumika kwa milingoti ya vyombo, katika ujenzi wa meli na kwa fanicha, na mbao zake ni kuni bora sana.

Nchini Kenya, mizizi huchemshwa na maji yake hutumika kutibu maambukizi ya mdomo na maumivu ya meno.

names.en: No Digo name has been recorded yet. In Swahili it is *msikundazi*, and it is also called *mkokoshi* and *mgongongo*. In English it is the looking-glass mangrove, for the mirror-like shine under its leaves, and its scientific name is *Heritiera littoralis*.
names.sw: Bado halijarekodiwa jina la Kidigo. Kwa Kiswahili unaitwa *msikundazi*, na pia huitwa *mkokoshi* na *mgongongo*. Kwa Kiingereza unaitwa *looking-glass mangrove*, kutokana na mng'ao kama wa kioo chini ya majani yake, na jina lake la kisayansi ni *Heritiera littoralis*.

conservation.en: It is rare in Kenya and grows only as scattered trees. Kenya's mangroves are heavily cut for poles and fuel, so harvesting is licensed by the Kenya Forest Service, and communities at Gazi, Makongeni and Vanga are restoring the forest.
conservation.sw: Ni adimu nchini Kenya na huota tu kama miti iliyotawanyika. Mikoko ya Kenya hukatwa kwa wingi kwa ajili ya boriti na nishati, kwa hiyo uvunaji hupewa leseni na Shirika la Misitu la Kenya (Kenya Forest Service), na jamii za Gazi, Makongeni na Vanga zinarejesha msitu.

reason.sw: Mkoko mwingine adimu wa upande wa nchi kavu unaotumika kwa milingoti ya vyombo

reason.sw: Hushiriki ukingo wa mikoko upande wa nchi kavu na hukatwa kwa ajili ya mbao
